output:
I'll start by discovering the tickets MCP tools.

I wrote the report to `/app/report.json` and the status file to `/app/STATUS.json`, with status `success`. I read all 18 open P1 tickets across the 4 result pages, plus each ticket's comments. I didn't change, comment on or create any ticket. I parsed both files back as JSON to check they were valid.

| Team | Open P1 | Unanswered |
|---|---|---|
| billing | 3 | 211, 231 |
| data | 5 | 214, 219 |
| identity | 4 | 220 |
| mobile | 2 | 228 |
| platform | 4 | 217 |

A ticket counts as unanswered when its only comments, if any, are from its own customer. For example, 211 has only a comment from its customer, so it is unanswered. Ticket 210 has a customer comment and a staff reply, so it counts as answered.
